open_points.subject: A1/A3 path opening
open_points.text: opened in non-blocking mode without following a link, what it finds is not a regular file
open_points.question: Must opening be anchored to the photo-folder directory and refuse symbolic links in every path component even when a previously checked parent is replaced by a link between metadata checking and opening, or does “without following a link” protect only the final component?
options: Open every component relative to anchored directory handles without following links; a raced link in any component makes the delivery fail.
Use ordinary path resolution with no-follow protection only on the final component; a raced parent-directory link may be followed.
open_points.default_guess: Anchor traversal to the photo folder and refuse links in every component.

witness.initial: The photo folder contains regular file sub/photo.jpg, the content named by the request has no placement, and the requested source_id matches a valid image outside the photo folder.
events: The deliverer checks sub and photo.jpg and finds no symbolic link.
Syncthing or another local actor replaces sub with a symbolic link to the outside directory before the file is opened.
outcomes: Component-anchored opening detects the raced symbolic link and returns failed with UNREADABLE_FILE without reading the outside file.
Final-component-only no-follow opening follows the new parent link, reads the outside image and can create a placement.
witness.observer: The caller sees failed versus placed, and filesystem auditing sees whether the outside file was read.

open_points.subject: INV-02 Required tests
open_points.text: INV-02: for content with no placement, an empty or absolute name, a name with an empty, `.` or `..` segment, an ignored name at any level, a folder, and a path through a symbolic link each fail with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure and add no file except the project lock (`test_a_name_a_scan_would_not_report_is_not_delivered`).
open_points.question: What must the test assert to demonstrate the invariant that no path failing A3 rule 5 condition 1 is opened, rather than merely demonstrating the refusal and final durable state, and must it cover the absent-path and unreadable-metadata branches of that condition?
options: Instrument the path-opening boundary and assert that no open occurs for every branch of condition 1, including absent components and metadata-read failure.
Treat the stated failure result and absence of added durable files for the listed examples as sufficient evidence.
open_points.default_guess: Assert through an opening spy or equivalent check that no open occurs, and cover every condition-1 branch.

open_points.subject: INV-19 Required tests
open_points.text: INV-19: delivering content that has no placement under the name of a conflict copy fails with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure, adds no file except the project lock and changes no existing file (`test_a_syncthing_conflict_copy_is_neither_offered_nor_placed`). Placed content replays when only a conflict copy still holds it (`test_placed_content_replays_when_only_a_conflict_copy_still_holds_it`), and an ordinary file with the content of a conflict copy is delivered (`test_an_ordinary_file_is_placed_when_a_conflict_copy_has_the_same_content`).
open_points.question: What must the Required test assert to show that a new placement never reads a conflict copy, since the described refusal and unchanged files can also result from an implementation that reads the file and rejects it afterward?
options: Instrument the reader and assert that the conflict-copy path is neither opened nor read before NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT is returned.
Treat the refusal and unchanged durable state as sufficient evidence that the file was not read.
open_points.default_guess: Assert at the file-reader boundary that the conflict copy is not opened or read.
